Conscious without compromise

Premium hosting crafted for your needs

We’ve spared no expense to create the best web hosting for you and the planet.

Hosting designed for you

Premium features as standard

Powerful cPanel control. Free SSL certificate. One-click installation of over 380 applications, including WordPress, Drupal, and OpenCart. Simple drag-and-drop website builder, plus unlimited bandwidth, email addresses, and databases.

A support team like no other

UK-based cloud hosting specialists

Our support staff are dedicated, passionate technologists who take pride in solving problems and keeping your business online. You can reach them quickly and easily through tickets, live chat or phone.

Seamless migration

An easy move to Krystal

Enjoy a smooth transition from your previous hosting company, whether they’re using cPanel, Plesk or their own system. We’ll work closely with you to make sure that your websites move with a minimum of disruption

State-of-the-art servers

Enterprise-grade servers for ultimate performance

All our web hosting is powered by our own proprietary enterprise-grade Dell cloud servers with dual CPUs, LiteSpeed caching and Samsung battery-backed SSDs. You won’t find better.

Safe and secure web hosting

Regular scanning, protection, and backups

When it comes to security, we spare no expense. We regularly run virus and malware scans, patch and update our servers and protect them with both firewalls and CloudLinux. We also provide 2.0 Tbps of DDoS protection as standard.

60-day money-back guarantee

No-quibble refunds

We’re confident you’ll love Krystal, but if you’re not entirely satisfied just let us know within 60 days. If we can’t make you happy we’ll refund you in full (minus domain costs, but you can transfer them away).

100% green powered web hosting

Yes, we obsess over our tech. But we also protect our planet.

Green energy

We use Ecotricity for our power, the first company in the UK to offer true 100% renewable energy.

Green data centres

All power consumed at our data centres comes from 100% renewable sources. All centres have achieved a PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) rating of at least 1.2.

Green purpose

We work with key partners including Ecologi, veritree and 1t.org to create a path to a cleaner future. We balance profit with purpose and are a Certified B Corp.

Green leadership

We work as a beacon for positive change, so we help our staff go green by offsetting their lifetime carbon footprint, and encourage our industry to adopt a planet-first approach.

Web hosting FAQs

The most-asked questions about our web hosting services and billing. Can’t find the answer? Check our Knowledge Base or drop us a line on .

When you have a website, the files that make up your website need to be stored somewhere that can be accessed by people around the world. Web hosting gives you that storage as well as the software needed to make your website work.

Each website is allocated space on a server, which is connected to the Internet and has software to ensure that each website has the necessary resources to run. Our hosting runs on our Katapult platform, which keeps copies of your website across many different servers to make sure your website stays online.

The number of websites you host will depend on the plan you purchase, as well as our Acceptable Use Policy.

We have over 200 applications that can be installed through our Softaculous one-click application installer, including WordPress, Joomla!, Drupal, and much more. You may also be able to install other software, depending on what the application requires and your technical capacity.

Because of the nature of the shared hosting platform, we cannot give you root access to the server.

We can’t make websites for you, but we do have a Website Builder that makes creating a website extremely easy.

You can have as many email addresses as you need, with 5GB mailboxes on our lower plans and 50GB mailboxes on our higher plans, plus as many forwarding email addresses as you need.

Your website will run on a Linux server that is part of our Katapult cloud server platform, and will be powered by 100% renewable energy. Read more about our technology platform.

You can always switch web hosting companies if you are unhappy with the service you are receiving. Krystal offers Switch Credits, which make it even easier to switch to us if you’re unhappy with your current web host.

Our Knowledge Base has many articles that cover all aspects of web hosting, and you may find the right article to help you.

If you still need help, please get in touch with our Support team, who are always happy to help.
